summary: On AAP 2.6, a Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform credential (controller URL plus username and password) lets rulebook activations launch job templates. Controller tokens used with 2.4 are deprecated in 2.6, so delete them and their activations before creating this credential.
questions: How do rulebook activations launch job templates in AAP 2.6?
Are controller tokens still supported for Event-Driven Ansible?
What is the Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform credential used for?
